# A requested cancellation can still end in completion

<!-- Generated by tests/e2e. Regenerate with ATLAS_E2E_UPDATE=1; review every change. -->

## 1. Start work that ignores cancellation

SDK `GET /dataset` with <operator key>

→ **200**
```json
{
  "id": "<id-1>",
  "writing_release": "0.1.0"
}
```

SDK `POST /plugins/fixture/operations` with <operator key>
```json
{
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "submission_id": "<submission>",
  "capability": "fixture.work",
  "input": {
    "label": "stubborn",
    "hold": true,
    "ignore_cancel": true
  }
}
```

→ **202** · Location `/plugins/fixture/operations/<id-2>`
```json
{
  "capability": "fixture.work",
  "created_at": "<time>",
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "error": null,
  "id": "<id-2>",
  "input": {
    "hold": true,
    "ignore_cancel": true,
    "label": "stubborn"
  },
  "output": null,
  "plugin_id": "fixture",
  "plugin_release": "1.0.0",
  "status": "pending",
  "submission_id": "<submission>"
}
```

## 2. Request cancellation

SDK `POST /plugins/fixture/operations/<id-2>/cancel` with <operator key>

→ **200**
```json
{
  "capability": "fixture.work",
  "created_at": "<time>",
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "error": null,
  "id": "<id-2>",
  "input": {
    "hold": true,
    "ignore_cancel": true,
    "label": "stubborn"
  },
  "output": {
    "label": "stubborn",
    "stage": "held"
  },
  "plugin_id": "fixture",
  "plugin_release": "1.0.0",
  "status": "cancellation_requested",
  "submission_id": "<submission>"
}
```

## 3. Progress keeps the cancellation request visible

SDK `POST /plugins/fixture/operations/<id-2>/reports` with <fixture plugin key>
```json
{
  "status": "in_progress",
  "output": {
    "label": "stubborn",
    "stage": "still running"
  }
}
```

→ **200**
```json
{
  "capability": "fixture.work",
  "created_at": "<time>",
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "error": null,
  "id": "<id-2>",
  "input": {
    "hold": true,
    "ignore_cancel": true,
    "label": "stubborn"
  },
  "output": {
    "label": "stubborn",
    "stage": "still running"
  },
  "plugin_id": "fixture",
  "plugin_release": "1.0.0",
  "status": "cancellation_requested",
  "submission_id": "<submission>"
}
```

## 4. The work finishes anyway and is recorded as completed
